{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.10

|gr1= Camera Control

|descr= Sets the position and direction for the camera used after camera is set on no object (log out view when leaving MP game for example)

|s1= [[setDefaultCamera]] [position, direction]

|p1= position: [[Position#PositionASL|PositionASL]] - position of the camera
|p2= direction: [[Vector3D]] - direction of the camera

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>setDefaultCamera [[5000, 5000, 200], [1, 1, -1]];</sqf>

|x2= Lift camera 100m up above current player position and point downwards:
<sqf>setDefaultCamera [ATLToASL (player modelToWorld [0, 0, 100]), [0, 0, -1]];</sqf>

|seealso= [[camCreate]] [[cameraOn]] [[cameraView]] [[cameraEffect]] [[cameraEffectEnableHUD]] [[switchCamera]] [[positionCameraToWorld]] [[cameraInterest]] [[setCameraInterest]] [[getEditorCamera]] [[mapCenterOnCamera]] [[preloadCamera]] [[restartEditorCamera]]
}}
